Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.sec1Desc: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit our platform. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners. Cookies cannot run programs or deliver viruses to your computer; they are uniquely assigned to your browser and can only be read by a web server in the domain that issued them to you.
Cookies.sec2Desc: EGFootball5 uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform. We use cookies to: (a) keep you logged into your account securely between sessions; (b) remember your language and locale preferences (Arabic/English, RTL/LTR); (c) maintain your booking cart or pending reservation state during the checkout process; (d) analyze aggregate platform usage through anonymized analytics with your explicit consent; and (e) deliver relevant features such as saved favorite pitches and match history.
Cookies.sec3Desc: We use the following categories of cookies: (a) Strictly Necessary Cookies: required for the platform to function and cannot be switched off. These include session authentication tokens via Firebase Authentication; (b) Functional Cookies: enable enhanced functionality such as remembering your preferred language and locale setting across sessions; (c) Analytics Cookies: with your consent, we use anonymized, aggregated analytics to understand how users interact with the platform, including pitch view counts and booking performance; (d) Third-Party Embeds: external map directions may set operational cookies subject to their own policies.
Cookies.sec4Desc: Authentication session cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with secure access to your account. These cookies are set by Firebase Authentication (a Google service) and expire when you log out or after an extended period of inactivity. Without these cookies, the platform cannot verify your identity or maintain your booking sessions, and core features such as pitch reservations and payment flows will not function.
Cookies.sec5Desc: You can control and customize cookie preferences at any time using our Cookie Preferences manager or through your browser settings. Most modern browsers allow you to view, allow, block, or delete cookies. Disabling strictly necessary cookies will prevent you from logging into the platform and completing bookings. Disabling functional cookies may cause preferences like language selection to reset on each visit.
Cookies.sec6Desc: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, regulation, or our business practices. Any significant changes will be communicated via in-app notification. Continued use of the platform after any update constitutes your acceptance of the revised Cookie Policy. If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at support@egfootball5.com.
Cookies.sec7Desc: This Cookie Policy is issued by EGFootball Sports Tech LLC (Commercial Registration: 194820, Tax ID: 712-492-301), Building 14, Youth Avenue, 9th District, Obour City, Egypt. Contact our privacy desk at legal@egfootball5.com.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1Desc: EGFootball Sports Tech LLC (شركة إيجي فوتبول لخدمات تكنولوجيا الرياضة وحجز الملاعب ش.م.م), registered in Egypt under Commercial Registration No. 194820 and Tax Card No. 712-492-301, located at Building 14, Youth Avenue, 9th District, Obour City, Egypt, acts as the Data Controller responsible for processing your personal data in accordance with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 151 of 2020) and applicable international standards.
Privacy.sec2Desc: We collect and process the following categories of personal information: (a) Account Information: your full name, mobile telephone number, email address, and optional avatar when you register; (b) Booking and Match Information: selected stadium, date and time slot, team player roster, position preference, and deposit payment verification receipts; (c) Technical Telemetry: IP address, device type, browser information, and session logs collected securely to prevent unauthorized access and fraud; (d) Communications: messages sent to support or pitch managers through the platform. We never collect or store payment card numbers; all deposits are verified via telecom cash receipts or InstaPay.
Privacy.sec3Desc: We process your personal data under the lawful grounds established by Egyptian Law No. 151 of 2020: (a) Contract Performance: to execute pitch reservations, verify deposits, lock slots, and grant digital match admission passes; (b) Legal Obligation: to retain transaction and invoicing records for three (3) years under Egyptian commercial and tax regulations; (c) Legitimate Interests: to protect platform security, prevent double-booking abuse, and enforce user conduct standards; (d) Explicit Consent: for non-essential analytics and marketing communications, which may be withdrawn at any time.
Privacy.sec4Desc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. Data is shared exclusively with: (a) Registered Stadium Managers: sharing player name and phone number strictly to facilitate your reserved slot at the physical pitch; (b) Infrastructure Subprocessors: Firebase and Google Cloud Platform for encrypted database storage and identity management under strict data processing agreements; (c) Judicial Authorities: only when required by binding court orders or official regulatory bodies in the Arab Republic of Egypt.
Privacy.sec5Desc: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to provide platform services. Booking records are preserved for three (3) years for statutory tax compliance. If you request account closure, your profile data and credentials will be permanently erased or anonymized within 30 days, subject to mandatory legal hold obligations.
Privacy.sec6Desc: We employ enterprise-grade security controls: (a) TLS 1.3 cryptographic transit encryption; (b) granular Firestore Security Rules preventing unauthorized cross-user reads and writes; (c) salted cryptographic password hashing handled by Firebase Authentication; (d) role-based access control isolating administrative tools; (e) rate limiting on all API endpoints to protect against brute-force and scraping attacks.
Privacy.sec7Title: 7. Your Rights under Law No. 151 of 2020
Privacy.sec7Desc: Under the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law, you have the right to: (a) access and obtain a copy of your personal data; (b) rectify inaccurate or incomplete records; (c) request erasure of your data; (d) restrict or object to unlawful processing; (e) receive your data in a portable, structured format; (f) withdraw consent at any time without retroactive penalty. To exercise any right, contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@egfootball5.com.
Privacy.sec8Desc: EGFootball5 is intended for players aged 16 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 16 without parental authorization. If we identify that an account belongs to a minor without parental consent, we will promptly delete the data.
Privacy.sec9Desc: In the unlikely event of a security breach involving personal data, we commit to notifying the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Center and affected users within 72 hours of becoming aware of the incident, outlining remediation steps taken.
Privacy.sec10Desc: For any legal, privacy, or data inquiries, reach out to our legal department at: EGFootball Sports Tech LLC, Email: legal@egfootball5.com, DPO Desk: dpo@egfootball5.com, Hotline: +20 10 1234 5678.

Terms.sec1Title: 1. Acceptance of Terms and Legal Entity
Terms.sec1Desc: By accessing or using the EGFootball5 platform, you enter into a legally binding contract with EGFootball Sports Tech LLC (Commercial Registration: 194820, Tax ID: 712-492-301, Obour City, Egypt). Terms.sec2Desc: Users must be at least 16 years of age. You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately at support@egfootball5.com if you suspect unauthorized access. Accounts with fraudulent or impersonated identities will be terminated immediately.
Terms.sec3Desc: Selecting a time slot locks that slot for 15 minutes (extended to 20 minutes for Pitch Pass VIP members) to enable deposit transfer. If deposit proof is not submitted before timer expiration, the slot is automatically released to other players. A confirmed booking is finalized only upon deposit verification by the pitch administrator.
Terms.sec4Desc: Required deposits must be paid via approved channels (Vodafone Cash or InstaPay) and verified with an uploaded transaction receipt. Submitting altered or forged receipts constitutes fraud, resulting in permanent blacklisting and legal referral.
Terms.sec5Desc: All booking cancellations and deposit refunds are strictly governed by our standalone Refund Policy: cancellations made > 24 hours prior to kick-off receive a 100% refund; cancellations 12 to 24 hours prior receive 50%; cancellations < 12 hours prior are non-refundable to compensate the stadium for unbooked turf time.
Terms.sec6Title: 6. Code of Conduct, Turf Safety, and Fair Play
Terms.sec6Desc: Players must respect stadium property, referees, opponents, and staff. Violence, harassment, abusive language, intentional pitch damage, and dangerous play are strictly prohibited. Violators will be permanently blacklisted across all partner venues.
Terms.sec7Title: 7. Assumption of Physical Risk and Injury Waiver
Terms.sec7Desc: Football on artificial turf involves inherent physical risks. Players participate entirely at their own risk. EGFootball5 and partner stadium operators are not liable for sports injuries, sprains, collisions, or personal belongings lost or damaged at partner venues.
Terms.sec8Desc: All platform branding, code, and trademarks are the exclusive property of EGFootball Sports Tech LLC. By submitting content (such as team logos or VAR highlight clips), you grant us a non-exclusive license to display the media on the platform.
Terms.sec9Title: 9. Governing Law and Egyptian Court Jurisdiction
Terms.sec9Desc: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt, including Consumer Protection Law No. 181 of 2018. Any unresolved dispute shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of Cairo, Egypt.

Refund.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
Refund.sec1Desc: This Refund and Cancellation Policy governs all reservations and deposit transactions processed on EGFootball5, operated by EGFootball Sports Tech LLC (CR: 194820, Tax ID: 712-492-301). Our policies are formulated in full alignment with Egyptian Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 181 of 2018) to ensure fair, transparent standards for both players and stadium operators.
Refund.sec2Desc: Players can cancel confirmed bookings directly through their Profile page. Refund eligibility depends on the time remaining before the scheduled kick-off: (a) Cancellations more than 24 hours prior: 100% full refund of the deposit or a full rescheduling credit voucher; (b) Cancellations between 12 and 24 hours prior: 50% refund of the deposit amount; (c) Cancellations less than 12 hours prior: Non-refundable, as the stadium has blocked the turf exclusively and cannot easily re-allocate the slot to other teams.
Refund.sec3Title: 3. Adverse Weather and Turf Force Majeure
Refund.sec3Desc: If an outdoor or covered pitch is declared unplayable due to heavy rain, extreme weather conditions, or unexpected power outage, players are entitled to an immediate 100% full deposit refund or free date/time rescheduling.
Refund.sec4Desc: Approved refunds are transferred back to the player via the original payment route (Vodafone Cash or InstaPay) within 24 to 48 business hours after support approval. No hidden administrative fees are deducted from valid weather or advance cancellations.
Refund.sec5Desc: In the rare event that a pitch operator cancels a confirmed slot due to private maintenance or administrative error, the player receives a 100% instant refund plus priority re-booking credit.
Refund.sec6Desc: For any questions or refund escalations, our resolution desk is available 7 days a week: Email: support@egfootball5.com, WhatsApp Support: +20 10 1234 5678. Inquiries are resolved within 2 business days.
